title: Apro language - Wikipedia
text: Apro, also known as Aproumu, is a language spoken by the Aizi people of Ébrié Lagoon in Ivory Coast. Once assumed to be a Kru language like the other two Aizi languages, subsequent investigation concluded it was Kwa [2][3] and then that it was unclassified within Volta–Congo [4]

title: Apro language — Grokipedia
text: Apro, also known as Aproumu or Aizi, is an endangered Niger-Congo language of the Atlantic–Congo branch spoken by approximately 12,000 people (as of 2016) in southeastern Côte d'Ivoire.
